h:
此工作流程旨在用于垂直方向的低分辨率屏幕。在触摸屏上摆弄 ComfyUI 通常是一场噩梦，因此它旨在最大限度地减少摆弄。您想要经常更改的所有内容都集中在左侧，这是默认情况下显示在浏览器窗口中的部分。与我之前发布的工作流程的一个主要区别是预览显示低分辨率 1024x1024 图像，因为在无法显示全部图像的屏幕上预览 2048x2048 图像是没有意义的。在 SM-T580 上进行测试。

依赖项：

  • 终极高档

    • https://github.com/ssitu/ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale

    • Ultimate SD Upscale 节点接受生成的低分辨率图像以及模型数据。

  • 效率节点

    • https://github.com/jags111/efficiency-nodes-comfyui

    • 这些做实际的工作。 LoRA Stacker 允许您设置多个 LoRA 和权重，并将其传递到加载器节点。加载程序接受模型和 VAE，以及提示和基本参数。这会将数据传递到 KSampler 节点，该节点会生成一批图像并将其模型数据传递到 Unpack 节点。 Unpack 节点将其模型输入拆分为 Upscale 节点可以读取的值。

  • ComfyUI 自定义脚本

    • https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts

    • 允许您锁定节点，以免意外移动它们。通常在桌面上不必要，但在移动设备上至关重要。

请注意，“保存”节点和“高档模型”节点默认情况下是压缩的，因为没有理由让它们一直处于展开状态。

此工作流程不支持 Adetailer、ControlNet 或修复，因为它的设计目的是让初学者尽可能简单。

o.en:
This workflow is intended for use on a vertically oriented low-resolution screen. Fiddling with ComfyUI on a touchscreen is generally a nightmare, so it's designed to minimize fiddling. All the stuff you'd want to change frequently is gathered on the left side, which is the portion displayed in your browser window by default. A major difference from previous workflows I've published is that the preview displays the low-res 1024x1024 images, since there's no point in previewing a 2048x2048 image on a screen that can't display all of it. Tested on an SM-T580.

Dependencies:

  • Ultimate Upscale

    • https://github.com/ssitu/ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale

    • The Ultimate SD Upscale node accepts the generated low-resolution images, as well as model data.

  • Efficiency Nodes

    • https://github.com/jags111/efficiency-nodes-comfyui

    • These do the actual work. A LoRA Stacker lets you set multiple LoRAs and weights, which get passed to the loader node. The loader accepts the models and VAE, as well as the prompts and basic parameters. This passes data to the KSampler node, which generates a batch of images and passes its model data to the Unpack node. The Unpack node splits its model input into values that can be read by the Upscale node.

  • ComfyUI Custom Scripts

    • https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts

    • Allows you to lock nodes so you don't accidentally move them. Usually unnecessary on a desktop but critical on mobile.

Note that the Save node and Upscale Model node are compressed by default, since there's no reason to leave them expanded all the time.

This workflow does not support Adetailer, ControlNet, or inpainting, as it's designed to be as simple as possible for beginners.
